def _apply_climb_action(sandbox, agent_body, step_count):
    control = agent_body.get("control", {})
    if not control:
        return
    cycle = control['cycle']
    phase = step_count % (2 * cycle)
    overlap = control.get('overlap', 10)
    speed = control.get('speed', 10.0)
    torque = control.get('torque', 100.0)
    joint = control['joint']
    
    if phase < cycle:
        # Activate torso pad and deactivate arm pad during the first phase
        for p in control['p_torso']:
            sandbox.set_pad_active(p, True)
        if phase > overlap:
            for p in control['p_arm']:
                sandbox.set_pad_active(p, False)
        else:
            for p in control['p_arm']:
                sandbox.set_pad_active(p, True)
        # Rotate the joint counterclockwise to climb
        sandbox.set_motor(joint, speed, max_torque=torque)
    else:
        # Activate arm pad and deactivate torso pad during the second phase
        for p in control['p_arm']:
            sandbox.set_pad_active(p, True)
        if (phase - cycle) > overlap:
            for p in control['p_torso']:
                sandbox.set_pad_active(p, False)
        else:
            for p in control['p_torso']:
                sandbox.set_pad_active(p, True)
        # Rotate the joint clockwise to descend or adjust position
        sandbox.set_motor(joint, -speed, max_torque=torque)

def agent_action(sandbox, agent_body, step_count):

    speed = control.get('speed', 2.0)
    torque = control.get('torque', 100.0)

        # Activate right pad, deactivate left
        for p in control['p_arm']: sandbox.set_pad_active(p, False)
        for p in control['p_torso']: sandbox.set_pad_active(p, True)

        sandbox.set_motor(control['joint_base'], speed, torque)

        for p in control['p_arm']: sandbox.set_pad_active(p, True)
